feudal.intro: The Feudal Age has one core counter cycle plus Men-at-Arms and towers. Counters here are about pierce armour and speed as much as bonus damage.

relations.why: Bonus damage + 3 pierce armour reduces the archer's hit to 1 damage.
2 pierce armour (skirm deals 1) and enough speed to chase fleeing skirmishers down.
Large attack bonus vs cavalry — the hardest counter in Feudal, but slow and fragile vs everything else.
Spearmen have low pierce armour and no answer to ranged fire.
Skirmishers also carry a bonus vs spearmen — don't use spears into skirms.
Men-at-Arms beat most Feudal units in a straight fight; only hit-and-run archers trouble them. Safe under a tower.

castle.intro: Castle Age adds compositions: a counter must actually kill its target, do it before the target tech-spikes, and not simply be kited. Knights dominate; Crossbows are the most common answer.

relations.why: Speed + armour close the gap; crossbows need big numbers or a Mangonel to hold.
Anti-cavalry bonus — but you need numbers, and pikes die to archers/infantry support.
Bonus vs cavalry and mobile enough to catch them; the cleanest mobile anti-knight.
Ranged fire shreds low-pierce-armour trash; protect them from cavalry.
Splash devastates massed archers — unless they are microed apart.
Fast melee closes and snipes siege; also great vs Monks and raiding.
High pierce armour hard-counters all archer-line and cavalry archers.
Conversion removes expensive units outright — but Monks die to archers and light cav.
Fast, gold-light, with bonus vs monks/siege/archers; a mesoamerican raiding answer.

archer.note: Cheap ranged DPS; fragile. Fletching/Bodkin are huge power spikes.

skirmisher.note: Trash counter to archers thanks to high pierce armour; useless vs melee.

spearman.note: Anti-cavalry trash. Slow and fragile to anything ranged or infantry.

scout-cavalry.note: Fast raider; 2 pierce armour beats skirms. Stopped cold by spears.

man-at-arms.note: Strong early Feudal aggression; safe under a tower. Kited by archers.

knight.note: The dominant Castle-Age unit: HP, attack, armour, speed — at ~2x cost.

crossbowman.note: Cheap upgrade from archers; the Xbow+Bodkin spike is unbeatable by Feudal units.

pikeman.note: Upgraded anti-cavalry trash; needs numbers and ranged support.

light-cavalry.note: Fast raider that snipes siege and Monks; trash-line so gold-free.

camel-rider.note: Bonus vs cavalry and mobile — the answer to Knight-heavy play.

cavalry-archer.note: Mobile ranged DPS; expensive and hard-countered by Skirmishers.

mangonel.note: Splash murders massed foot; dies to mobile melee and is beaten by micro.

scorpion.note: Linear bolt shreds tight formations; immobile and siege-vulnerable.

monk.note: Converts single expensive units and heals; very fragile to ranged + speed.

eagle-warrior.note: Fast, gold-light raider; bonus vs siege/monks/archers but loses to heavy infantry.

battering-ram.note: Demolishes buildings and absorbs arrows for your army; helpless once units swarm it.
